metric_definition.success_old: mean of per-task success/all 1 assignment for old_milk and old_drawer
metric_definition.weights_basis: Engineering priority: basic task 40%, controlled position robustness 35%, two old-capability probes macro-averaged 25%; critical old preservation separately protected. Chosen before candidate outcomes; no estimated utility or statistical guarantee.

cost_policy: All costs are recorded as a resource vector and constrained by budget, not also deducted from J.

hard_constraints.safety: No confirmed execution safety or governance breach; native finite action, configured step/timeout and tool permissions remain enforced; missing evidence=null.
hard_constraints.compatibility: Model, processor, normalization, observations/actions, native chunk protocol and bundle artifacts are compatible with recorded backend contract; missing checks=null.
hard_constraints.critical_old_preserved: old_milk and old_drawer each established at seed3; candidate succeeds on both, never below matched current or fixed anchor.
hard_constraints.reference_coverage: All four release slots require independent native/terminal results and necessary L0, technical, complete cost and critical_progress evidence. Auxiliary training collection alone is not a permanent release prerequisite; unknown/invalid/missing necessary evidence => inconclusive.
hard_constraints.resource_limits: No per-attempt or aggregate authorized resource cap exceeded; missing full-cost ledger=null.
hard_constraints.critical_progress: No confirmed duplicate completion submission, action using invalidated historical coordinates, or advance that requires an unverified holding/goal fact. Only preconditions actually consumed by executed skills are required; reference evidence for those transitions must be available or this check=null. Optional released/settled labels are not new native success conditions.

outcomes.denominator: All preassigned task-seed slots, including refused, unstarted due to batch stop, timeout, unknown and invalid. One slot remains one denominator entry; no replacement or post-outcome exclusion.
outcomes.success: Independent native benchmark success=true, linked episode/bundle/protocol; Planner finish, tool heuristic or terminated alone cannot establish success.
outcomes.failure: Independent native success=false after authorized attempt ends or budget is exhausted with complete terminal evidence.
outcomes.unknown: Independent result absent/conflicting, or stopped slot not run; never infer success from no alarm.
outcomes.invalid: Technical setup/protocol/data failure flag, independent of outcome; score contribution zero and counts in all-slot denominator.
outcomes.score_contribution: 1 only for success AND valid; all other slots 0.
outcomes.gate_missing_fraction: union(outcome=unknown, validity=invalid, missing slot) / all assigned slots; must equal zero for accept in each of candidate/current/anchor.
outcomes.native_definition: Release/settle labels are process evidence only; do not silently strengthen or replace the native benchmark goal.

state_evaluation.sampling: At initial observation, after each state-changing tool, each handoff/recovery, and terminal observation; only task-applicable states are expected and the set is fixed before the attempt.
state_evaluation.zero_denominator: null, never 0 or 1; required evidence missing leads inconclusive
state_evaluation.privileged_state: Evaluator-only reference does not enter runtime policy. Unknown ground truth remains missing reference; system statements do not supply the reference.

recovery.mid_attempt_reset: Terminates original attempt, record linked new attempt if separately authorized. No reset retry authorized by this pilot. Never upgrade original slot to success from retry.
recovery.causal_claim: Triggered recovery samples alone do not identify recovery benefit. A future causal comparison needs preallocated independent controls under same budget.

gate.accept: All three results complete/valid, all named hard constraints true, dynamic authorization present, J(candidate)-J(current)>=0.02, J(candidate)>=J(anchor)-0.02.
gate.reject: Known hard-constraint false, or complete comparable evidence fails fixed numerical thresholds.
gate.inconclusive: Unknown/invalid/missing results, null constraints, unresolved compatibility, missing authorization or insufficient evidence. Keep current effective bundle.
gate.priority: Known hard violation rejects; otherwise missing evidence/authorization is inconclusive before comparing numeric score.
gate.statistical_status: One seed/task gives finite engineering coverage only; no efficacy or H3 inference.
gate.anchor_policy: Initial full immutable RunBundle and independent release matrix become fixed anchor; first current may reuse that same result. Later current updates cannot replace anchor. Existing smoke is not anchor acceptance.
gate.activation: Task boundary only, separate from evaluation; reject/inconclusive cannot change effective bundle.
gate.engineering_threshold_resolution: Each old-task slot changes J by .125, controlled by .35, base by .40; min_gain=.02 is a fixed engineering rule, no confidence claim.

first_release_cycle_proposal.currency_budget: Future comparison only, not authorized. Tokens observed only; no token or money hard-cap commitment.

budget.stop_rule: Before every model HTTP forwarding reserve one request; at20 reject before upstream. At wall/tool/total env-step/GPU-envelope/storage threshold stop and retain full preassigned slots. Tokens observed only by explicit user authorization, no token spend guarantee.
budget.wall_clock: Use run.log or supervisor process launch-to-final-cleanup timestamps; include startup/loading/shutdown and failed attempts; never use transcript.elapsed_s as full job time.
budget.token_policy: observed_only; input/cached/output retained, not a hard token/spend cap

next_step_proposal.launch_condition: No automatic dispatch; only the current unique trial is eligible via new permit.
next_step_proposal.completion: Raw native success/terminated/truncated and separate process labels persisted with bundle/protocol; complete start-to-cleanup wall clock and token ledger; missing outcome remains unknown. Pilot supports that scene only.
